_comment: Identical to lighthouserc.json except the is-crawlable audit is skipped (W91). A Vercel preview's robots.txt is face-aware and answers Disallow: / (e2e/helpers/face.ts, src/app/robots.ts), which the is-crawlable audit would fail — dragging categories:seo below 1.0 for a reason that has nothing to do with this page's own SEO markup. Skipping the audit removes it from the SEO category's score instead of loosening the assertion; every other SEO check (meta description, viewport, canonical, etc.) still has to score 1.0. gate.sh (and js-size --routes) pass this file to lhci collect AND lhci assert whenever the target wears the preview face — a *.vercel.app host, staging.jobsadmire.com, or NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_FACE set to anything but production (lighthouseConfigFor, e2e/helpers/face.ts; W135/W137): skipAudits is a collect-time setting, so a config handed to assert alone never skips the audit. Production runs (after WP7a) use lighthouserc.json with the audit live. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md § Quality gate.
